submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires retrospectively when the current token continues or completes a fixed, highly predictable multi-token chunk: an idiomatic binomial or collocation (quickly and easily, early and late, Fast and Furious), a degree/quantity/time formula (for quite some, little if any, at any time, at least, somewhat or not), a contraction stem (don/doesn toward n't), a hyphenated compound (moderate-intensity, early-stage), or a mid-word subword continuation inside a long complex word (Ther|ape|utic, neutrop|en|ia, Multifl|or|i). The same surface tokens in novel compositional combinations (John and Mary, quite good, walked in the park, harmful treatment) evoke little or no response, and output-lens projection is incoherent (Jacobian kurtosis ~3.1), so the pole detects chunk continuity in what was just read rather than preparing any specific upcoming token.
